prompt: I need to name a class that accept post request from client and save request in memory, then launch an internal service and wait for the real processor to connect. The real processor will get the input, process and return the result through the connection. After receive the result from the real processor, the class will return the result to the client. Please give me the class name
response: A suitable name for this class could be `RequestForwarder`. This name reflects the role of the class in forwarding client requests to an internal service and then returning the results. It emphasizes the intermediary nature of the class in the request-response cycle.
